SAF — Safari

Mikumi or Nyerere fly-in day safari

8–10 hours · Zanzibar → mainland Tanzania → Zanzibar

From $400–$800 per person
Book via WhatsApp

Overview

Escape to mainland Tanzania for a thrilling day safari. Fly from Zanzibar to either Mikumi National Park (famous for the "S" curve of the river) or Nyerere National Park (formerly Selous Game Reserve, vast wetlands and wildlife). Return the same evening.

What to Expect

  • Morning flight from Zanzibar to Mwanza or Dar es Salaam (chartered, 1.5 hours)
  • 4-hour game drive in 4x4 with a licensed Tanzanian guide
  • Park fees, lunch, and refreshments included
  • Evening return flight to Zanzibar
  • Spot elephants, lions, hippos, crocodiles, giraffes, and over 400 bird species

Duration & Meeting Point

Duration: Full day (8–10 hours including flights)

Meeting point: Abeid Amani Karume International Airport (ZNZ) — transfer from your hotel included

Important Notes

  • Flight-dependent — weather permitting only
  • Must use a licensed mainland operator (we handle this)
  • Minimum 2 passengers for charter flights — single supplement applies
  • Best months: June–October and December–March (dry seasons)

Inclusions

  • Flights, game drive, park fees, lunch
